features.name: Document Chunking
features.description: IndexingService splits documents into ~500 char chunks at paragraph boundaries with metadata
features.evidence: chunkDocument() splits at paragraph boundaries until ~500 chars, storing charCount/wordCount per chunk. startIndexing(documentId) now registers chunk IDs in index-meta.json and flips the document status to 'indexed' with its chunk count (both were missing, which broke status/getAllChunks/grounded QA after single-doc indexing); full-library indexing flips statuses too. Verified: npm run check passes; service-level behavior test imported two docs, indexed one individually and both via bulk, and confirmed chunks files, index-meta.json registration, document statuses, and getAllChunks().

features.name: Metadata Extraction
features.description: On import, extract word count, line count, file type, and paragraph count metadata from documents
features.evidence: Added DocumentMetadata interface (wordCount, lineCount, fileType, paragraphCount, charCount) to shared/types.ts and a metadata?: DocumentMetadata field on Document. Implemented DocumentService.extractMetadata() computing all five metrics from raw content and filename; importDocument() attaches the result. DocumentDetail renders a metadata section with all five fields. Verified: npm run check passes with zero errors; service-level behavior test imported a sample .md and confirmed all metrics plus persistence in documents-meta.json.

features.name: Indexing Status in StatusBar
features.description: StatusBar shows indexing progress with indexed count, total chunks, and color-coded status indicator
features.evidence: Added indexedCount and totalChunks to AppStatus interface in shared/types.ts. Updated IndexingService.getStatus() to return AppStatus with indexedCount (number of documents with chunks) and totalChunks (sum of all chunk arrays). Enhanced StatusBar to display 'Indexed: 2/3 docs (45 chunks)' line. Updated App.tsx default status to include new fields. Verified: npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json passes.

features.name: Grounded Q&A with Citations
features.description: QaService returns answers with document citations, excerpts, and confidence scores
features.evidence: QaService.ask() retrieves chunks via IndexingService.getAllChunks(), scores by keyword overlap, returns top 2 as citations with documentId/documentTitle/chunkIndex/excerpt. Mock patterns generate contextual answers. Confidence: 0.85 with citations, 0.30 without. Verified: main.ts now passes the shared indexingService instance to QaService, so grounded retrieval works without duplicating persistence state. npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json passes.
